decision_contract.notice_check_allowed: Metadata supports acquiring the official text file only to verify its internal notice, edition, credits, and contributors. This is not a public-domain declaration or admission of prose.
decision_contract.hold_term_likely_active: Available author and publication evidence indicates that Japanese protection may still subsist. Do not acquire or inspect the ebook for this frame.
decision_contract.hold_identity_or_death_unverified: The credited author's legal identity or death year was not established well enough to calculate the Japanese term. Do not acquire or inspect the ebook for this frame.

japan_rules_applied: Terms run from January 1 of the year after death, publication, or creation as applicable.
The ordinary term changed from 50 to 70 years on 2018-12-30.
A term already expired on 2018-12-29 is not revived.
A work still protected on 2018-12-29 because of wartime addition receives the extended term.
The published Allied-country wartime additions range up to 4,180 days; exact country, rights-holder, acquisition date, and reciprocity still require work-level checking.
method.text_only_scope: Images, cover art, ornamental art, image-only credits, and illustration-specific captions or alt text are excluded. An illustrator does not block the author's prose merely because the illustrator is credited; any contributor-authored prose, notes, or captions must be screened separately.
method.content_blindness: Decisions use catalog creator metadata and bibliographic or legal sources, never topic, acceptability, lexical yield, MWE presence, or sense distribution.

incidental_search_exposure.description: Rights-oriented Web search results exposed automatically generated descriptions, front matter, or short source-text snippets for these fixed-rank works. No ebook file was acquired, no complete unit was selected, and no word or MWE query was run. Frozen ranks and first-intact-unit rules remain unchanged, so the exposure cannot alter selection.

A public Web app is globally reachable: United States and Japanese checks do not authorize bundling or serving source text worldwide. Until a release territory or globally valid permission is fixed, Project Gutenberg prose stays local and the public app receives no source passage.
Project Gutenberg's United States status is not treated as Japanese clearance.
The screen does not infer audience suitability, instructional quality, representativeness, MWE yield, meaning, or coverage.
Illustrator exclusion applies only to a text-only derivative and cannot erase contributor-authored prose, notes, captions, or edition-specific material.
Secondary identity evidence can justify a conservative hold but cannot by itself justify release.
